title: Need help looking for an ai chat based game
author: long_thick8
selftext: For a few months now ive been interested in ai chatting and specifically roleplay games. I started out with ourdream ai which is an nsfw website but it had a new york roleplay game that was open world and i thought it was really cool and unsurprisingly for a nsfw ai it had really good descriptions and the chatacter dialogue was great but it was really expensive and there wasnt any customization. I moved on to grok which was a bit repetative and boring then i tried dungeon ai which has been my go too but the subscriptions are very expensive, the character dialogue is really cringy and weird and the descriptions are vague, way to off topic, difficult to visualise, and every chat starts with lots of useless, out of place descriptions before it actually reacts to my prompt. I was hoping to get some recommendations for ai that i could try out.
